headline: Flagler defeats Emory & Henry to face Fort Hays State
dek: The Peach Belt program moved to sixteen wins and five draws with only one defeat all season. Charleston and Cal State San Bernardino meet in the division's other remaining match, while the South Atlantic Conference has yet to record the result.
